interface.name: denial_fingerprint_manager_v1
interface.description:
This experimental extension coordinates optical fingerprint presentation with compositor-owned output power and local panel illumination. It is available only to a compositor-authorized fingerprint presentation agent. An application identifier or the ability to connect to Wayland is not authorization. Unsupported hardware must fail rather than silently substitute global maximum brightness.
Image buffers contain a presentation image, never biometric samples. Authentication remains in the compositor's trusted authentication path. No request in this protocol can unlock a session or assert a match.

entry.name: invalid_sensor
entry.summary: sensor has no configured presentation profile

request.name: get_session
request.description: The sensor identifier resolves to trusted compositor configuration specifying the output, physical geometry and illumination requirements. The compositor sends configured before accepting present. Creating a session does not wake the screen or enable illumination.

interface.name: denial_fingerprint_session_v1

description.summary: bounded fingerprint contact and illumination session

interface.description:
Session states are configured, preparing, ready and stopping. One contact is active at a time. The client coalesces repeated hardware DOWN reports until UP. Every new contact uses a new, nonzero serial, increasing within this session. Events refer to that serial; stale events never authorize acquisition for a newer contact.
If the target output was off, the compositor wakes it with an exclusive scene: opaque black with only the supplied image at the configured sensor rectangle. Normal shell, applications, cursor and overlays must not appear during this screen-off wake. If the output was already on, its normal UI remains visible and the fingerprint image is overlaid at that rectangle. Local illumination affects only the sensor region in both cases. Output rotation and scale must not move the image away from the physical sensor. Session lock state is preserved.
On UP, timeout, output loss, client disconnect or revocation, the compositor disables local illumination and releases the presentation. It may retain an opaque black scene for a short bounded idle interval to permit quick retries and a smooth authenticated wake. A compositor-owned copy of the presentation image may briefly remain at ordinary brightness during authentication handoff and fade together with the black scene on trusted unlock. This never extends acquisition readiness or client buffer use beyond release. It then restores the previous screen-off state unless a subsequent independent user wake or successful trusted authentication superseded it. A wake cancellation must never briefly expose a parked ordinary UI frame.

entry.name: invalid_state
entry.summary: request is invalid in this state

entry.name: invalid_geometry
entry.summary: geometry differs from the trusted sensor profile

entry.name: invalid_buffer
entry.summary: buffer format, dimensions or import is unsupported

entry.name: invalid_serial
entry.summary: serial is zero, stale or reused

entry.name: unavailable
entry.summary: output, import or local illumination failed

request.name: destroy
request.description: Any active presentation is cancelled. Buffer use and local illumination must terminate even if the client disconnects without this request.

request.name: present

description.summary: report finger down with a DMA-BUF presentation image

request.description:
The buffer must be created through linux-dmabuf and match width and height exactly. Coordinates are the rectangle's top-left in native, unrotated panel pixels, not desktop logical coordinates. The rectangle must match configured. The compositor validates format, dimensions, output identity and device policy before using the buffer.
Ordinary DMA-BUF implicit synchronization applies. The client must not modify or reuse the buffer until wl_buffer.release. It must retain the wl_buffer object until release or connection teardown. An accepted present does not authorize capture: wait for ready with this serial.
The compositor enforces a bounded presentation timeout independently of client responsiveness. Only one present may be outstanding; await stopped before beginning a new contact.

request.name: withdraw

description.summary: report finger up or cancel capture

request.description: Cancels this serial in preparing or ready state. Already stopped serials are ignored. Zero or a serial newer than the last present is an error. This request is also used after capture completes; authentication results travel through the separate trusted authentication service.

event.name: configured

description.summary: trusted output geometry and presentation limit

event.description: The output name identifies the configured physical panel. Geometry is fixed in native panel pixels regardless of desktop rotation or scale. max_duration_ms bounds a single active contact, not idle session time.

event.name: ready

description.summary: safe to acquire for this contact

event.description: Sent only after the specific black-and-image frame has reached scanout, local panel illumination is active and the configured settling interval has elapsed. Merely importing a buffer, submitting a frame or receiving a wl_surface.frame callback does not establish this readiness.

event.name: stopped
event.description: Local illumination is off and this contact is no longer eligible for acquisition. Buffer lifetime is independently indicated by release. Any capture still in progress must be cancelled.
